title.rendered: Upcoming QCWA Zoom presentation by Tom Schiller, N6BT on March 27th at 10 AM

content.rendered:
The Quarter Century Wireless Association Chapter 228 invites you to attend our March 27, 2021 virtual meeting that features a presentation on antennas by Tom Schiller, N6BT.Tom who is an internationally known ham and antenna maker who founded Force 12 Antennas many years ago.  To obtain the link for zoom access, please contact Chapter 228 President Ron Luttringer, K6XC at ronk6xc@gmail.com .

Here is what ARRL wrote about the “Array of Light (Next Generation Antennas) book.  “For years Tom Schiller, N6BT, has broken new ground in antenna design and use. This book is full of all of the lessons he has learned over the years. It is profusely illustrated and has dozens of pictures and performance information. Tom, N6BT has given dozens of talks on antenna theory and performance and was the founder of Force 12 Antennas, which produced many innovative antennas for amateur and commercial use. Tom is donating a signed copy of his “Array of Light (Next Generation Antennas) book to the QCWA and proceeds will  go to the Quarter Century Wireless Association Scholarship Fund.
